reviewed.notes: Endpoints observed live with the automation account (stephen+hstudio, tenant [1150]): Create risk -> POST /api/company/1150/firm_oversight/risks/ {scenario, guidance, notes, manual_id:-1, inherent_risk_impact}; Create Control -> POST /api/company/1150/firm_oversight/controls/ {display_name, description, risk_ids:[], test_ids:[], policy, procedures, manual_id:-1}. Both respond 200 with the WHOLE list ({data:[...]}), so the id is taken from the item whose name equals the run's labelled name. Row menu Delete -> DELETE .../risks/{id}/ and .../controls/{id}/ (200, hard delete; item GET is 405, so presence/absence is checked on the list). Effects are confined: a standalone risk/control with no links (risk_ids/test_ids empty, no manual) sends nothing to anyone; the only side effects are analytics beacons, which the guard aborts. Records carry no created_by field, so ownership = unique run label + this run's journal + the create response observed in this run.
